appStore.name: Saakshi
appStore.subtitle: Record and protect your rights
appStore.promotionalText: Record photos and video with a signed fingerprint, send a witness message, prepare your section 63 certificate, and alert your trusted contacts. In English and Hindi.
description: Saakshi ("witness") helps you protect yourself and your rights in India. Record what happens to you, keep a record that shows it has not been changed, let the people you trust know where you are, and know what to do, in English and Hindi.
RECORD FOR YOUR OWN RECORDS
• Take photos and video inside the app.

• When a file closes, Saakshi computes its SHA-256 fingerprint and signs a record of it (time, place, phone, app version) with a key kept in your phone's security chip. The files in a session are chained together, so a file added or removed later shows.
• The original file is never changed.
• Body-cam mode: wear the phone on your chest and keep your hands free. The screen goes dark and locks while it records.
• Short reminders of your rights while you record, drawn on the screen only, never into the video.
KEEP AND SHARE YOUR RECORDS
• Witness message: send the fingerprint, time and place by SMS to people you choose, so they also hold proof of what you recorded and when.

• Certificate: section 63(4) of the Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023 asks for a certificate in the form in its Schedule with an electronic record. Saakshi fills in Part A and attaches the hash report. Part B must be signed by an expert.
• Export a bundle (original files, signed records, certificate) through the share sheet, for you and your lawyer. Anyone can check it with open tools.
ALERT YOUR TRUSTED CONTACTS
• Add the people you trust. They are kept only on your phone.
• SOS opens a message to all of them with your location and the time; you tap Send.
• Saakshi is not an emergency service. 112 is always one tap away.
KNOW WHAT TO DO
• Verified helpline numbers, including 112 and free legal aid.
• Guides: wearing your phone on your chest, digital safety before you go out, and staying in touch without the internet.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no analytics, no tracking.
• Your recordings, contacts and location stay on your phone unless you send them.
• Free and open source (MIT): github.com/AayushTainwala/Saakshi
Published by Aayush Tainwala, Advocate. Saakshi gives general information, not legal advice on your situation.
